rule: When the user requests a changed World_server plus a link, a progress/status/root-cause report is not a valid final output. Continue through repair, merge, deploy and fresh browser verification until a working canonical link exists, unless an owner-only action is truly required. Canonical deployment/stack identity is Cloudflare (data/cloudflare-deployment-identity.json, delivery:verify exact-SHA gate); the canonical PUBLIC host for user-facing final links is https://world-server.netlify.app, verified at /apps/voxel-world/ and /shared/world-fusion.html. A Netlify deploy-preview alias is never canonical evidence.
